_readme: Corrections to TCGdex's `legal.standard` flag, which can lag for newly released
or special sets. Curation wins over the API.
includeSets: TCGdex-set ids whose cards are treated as Standard legal regardless
of what the API reports. excludeSets: the reverse.
30th / 30th-c (30th Celebration, 30th Classic Collection) are reported as
standard:false by TCGdex but are Standard legal in play - confirmed by the user,
2026-10-28. Without this, cards such as `Mew ex 30C 66` are dropped.
